errors.text_span: Графиката включва три линии: синята линия, означена като „EU; 0,7483“... Червената пунктирена линия, означена като „EU; 0,7556“, започва при 0,7556 в 2014 г. и достига 0,8525 в 2020 г., като също показва стабилно нарастване.
errors.evidence: The chart contains only two data lines (blue for EU, orange for BG). The description incorrectly identifies three lines, inventing a third data series by misinterpreting one of the two red dashed trend lines and assigning it a data label from the blue line.
The description of the blue line claims it shows 'gradual growth', but the line actually dips from a value of 0.7483 in 2012 to 0.7300 in 2014 before it starts to increase.
The description states that the orange line (BG) reaches a value of 0.7177 in 2020. However, the chart shows its final value in 2020 is 0.798. The value 0.7177 corresponds to the year 2018.
The description completely fails to mention or describe the two red dashed lines that are clearly visible on the chart. Instead, it hallucinates one of them as a data series.

errors.text_span: има маркери във всеки годишен интервал.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the data lines have markers. However, the lines are solid with no visible markers (such as circles, squares, etc.); the data points are simply labeled with their numerical values.

errors.text_span: Всички линии са означени с текстови етикети
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect because the two red dashed lines do not have any text labels associated with them.
